Updater: prefer the update site's current versions to locally-cached ones

A rather embarrassing bug entered the ImageJ Updater which prevents
it from updating components because local db.xml.gz's versions are
preferred over those from the update site.

diff --git a/core/updater/core/src/main/java/imagej/updater/core/XMLFileReader.java b/core/updater/core/src/main/java/imagej/updater/core/XMLFileReader.java
ind...

result.reasoning: This commit introduced the `filesFromThisSite` Set used to track which files belong to the currently-processed update site, replacing the old per-file updateSite comparison logic. However, it never resets/clears this set at the start of each call to `read()`, so when multiple update sites are processed sequentially (each site calling read() again), stale entries from previous sites remain in the set, causing files to be incorrectly treated as belonging to the current site and preventing proper shadowing/overriding behavior. The fix commit directly addresses this by adding `filesFromThisSite.clear()` at the start of `read()`, exactly compensating for the omission introduced in this commit.
